acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

Mass spectrometry was conducted using a data-dependent acquisition mode, where MS1 spectra were measured with a resolution of 60,000, a normalized AGC target of 300%, and a mass range from 350 to 1800 m/z.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The samples were subsequently reduced with 4 mM DTT for 30 minutes at RT with shaking at 1000 rpm, followed by alkylation with 10 mM Iodoacetamide for 45 min in the dark at RT while shaking at 1000 rpm.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The samples were subsequently reduced with 4 mM DTT for 30 minutes at RT with shaking at 1000 rpm, followed by alkylation with 10 mM Iodoacetamide for 45 min in the dark at RT while shaking at 1000 rpm.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Digestion parameters were set to “trypsin allow P” with an allowance of 4 missed cleavages.

collision_energy.evidence: MS2 spectra were acquired for the top 20 most abundant ions per cycle at a resolution of 45,000, an AGC target of 30%, an isolation window of 0.7 m/z and a normalized collision energy of 34.

fractionation_method.evidence: The combined TMT-labeled peptide sample was fractionated by basic reverse phase (bRP) fractionation using an in-house packed SDB-RPS (3M) StageTip.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were eluted into the Orbitrap Exploris 480 at a flow rate of 200 nL/min.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: All peptide samples were separated and analyzed on an online liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) system, consisting of a Vanquish Neo UPHLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to an Orbitrap Exploris 480 (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: Desalted peptides were labeled with TMTpro reagents (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
